terms.latin: partēs prīncipālēs, partium prīncipālium f. pl.
terms.gloss: the principal parts of a verb
terms.comment: doceō, docēre, docuī, doctus (Traupman 230). The term of modern grammars; we have not found it in Lewis & Short.

phrases.english: Give the principal parts of the verb doceō.

sources: Lewis & Short: pars · Lewis & Short: principalis
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 230, p. 245, p. 248, p. 365.
